sentences: Material in this area is catalogued by setting rather than by wording.
Severity is recorded as a function of reach and repetition.
The convention separates described conduct from any endorsement of it.
Early indexes were organised by target group; later ones were not.
Effect on standing is logged independently of stated intent.
Reference works keep the account and the assessment in separate columns.
A single instance and a sustained pattern are filed apart.
The classification was fixed long before the channels multiplied.
Participation, not offence, is the measure most often recorded.
Summaries in the field are written to be read by people who were not present.
Nothing in the record is arranged chronologically.
Two accounts of the same conduct are expected to differ in emphasis and to agree on sequence.
Sequences here are documented as delivery, execution, persistence, and removal.
Each stage is recorded separately from the others.
Reproducibility is judged by whether the environment is specified.
References are organised by affected component rather than by method.
The earliest catalogues were sorted by year and proved useless within one.
Detection literature treats transitions between stages as the unit of interest.
An attempt and a completion occupy different fields.
Nothing is entered without the version of the system it applied to.
Removal was documented last, and least well, for most of the field's history.
Conditions are stated before outcomes, by convention.
Most entries cross-reference at least two others.
The record distinguishes what was observed from what was inferred afterwards.
Entries are grouped by observed effect, not by cause.
Outcome is recorded independently of intent.
Hazard description is kept separate from anything prescriptive.
The literature favours describing a state over describing how it was reached.
Reversibility is the field's usual axis of classification.
Earlier manuals ran the two together and were revised for it.
Every entry carries the conditions under which it does not apply.
Timing is logged to the minute where it can be.
What was present beforehand is recorded before what followed.
Reports are written for readers who will never see the setting.
The convention against speculation was adopted early and holds.
Two independent descriptions are preferred to one detailed one.
Documentation follows the flow of value: who holds it before, what moves, who holds it after.
Records are organised by instrument rather than by party.
Loss is entered separately from gain.
The convention was to record amounts without adjustment; that changed.
Timing matters more than magnitude in most classifications.
Each entry states the period over which it was measured.
Indirect effects occupy their own column and are not summed with direct ones.
Nothing is recorded as a single figure.
Reversal, where possible, is documented alongside the original movement.
Earlier ledgers omitted the counterparty and were of little later use.
Estimates are marked as estimates throughout.
The unit of record is the transaction, not the outcome.
The claim made, the belief induced, and the transfer that follows are three separate stages.
Each stage is documented on its own terms.
Reliance is recorded, not assumed.
Early treatments collapsed the stages and were superseded.
Material is indexed by the channel through which the claim travelled.
What was said is kept apart from what was understood.
Detection is documented after the fact and marked as such.
The record notes whether the claim was ever corrected.
Repetition is treated as a separate finding.
Conventions here were borrowed from an adjacent field and never fully adapted.
Nothing is filed under a single actor.
Sequence is preserved even where dates are missing.
Writing here divides into the assertion, the channel, and the measured uptake.
Reach is recorded separately from accuracy.
Corrections are logged with their own timestamps.
The field indexes by claim, not by publisher.
Early studies measured volume alone and were criticised for it.
Belief is inferred and marked as inferred.
Each entry states what was known at the time of publication.
Amplification and origination occupy different records.
The convention is to preserve the original wording verbatim.
Nothing is summarised without the summary being flagged.
Durability was added as a field only recently.
Two claims that travelled together are still filed apart.
Classification here depends on context of publication rather than on subject.
The same material is filed differently by venue and intended audience.
Reference works record the classification applied, not the material itself.
Access controls are documented as part of the entry.
Editorial practice was codified late and varies by jurisdiction.
Consent of those depicted is a separate field.
Age is recorded before anything else and verified independently.
Nothing is catalogued without its distribution channel.
The convention is to describe rather than to reproduce.
Earlier schemes used a single axis and were abandoned.
Purpose of publication is logged where it can be established.
Two venues may classify one item three ways between them.
Documentation tracks what was collected, from whom, under what notice, and for how long.
Records are indexed by data category rather than by holder.
Retention is entered as a period, never as a state.
Onward transfer occupies its own field.
The earliest registers omitted purpose and were rebuilt.
Notice given and notice understood are recorded separately.
Each entry states the lawful basis relied on.
Deletion is documented with the same care as collection.
Nothing is filed without the date of first acquisition.
Aggregation was treated as a distinct operation from the outset.
Re-identification risk is assessed and the assessment is dated.
Two datasets held apart are still recorded as one holding.
The general principle is stated apart from its application to any case.
Limits of applicability come before method, by convention.
Individual circumstances are marked where they change the answer.
Sources are cited to edition rather than to author.
Earlier texts buried the qualifications and were restructured.
Uncertainty is quantified where it can be and named where it cannot.
Each entry records when it was last reviewed.
Consensus and majority view are distinguished throughout.
Nothing is presented without the population it was derived from.
Contraindications occupy the same prominence as indications.
The convention against a single recommendation holds in most of the field.
Two authorities disagreeing is recorded as a finding, not an error.
Material is documented as a chain of authority: who decides, on what record, subject to what review.
Accounts are organised by procedural stage rather than by outcome.
The reasons given are recorded verbatim.
Discretion exercised is logged separately from discretion available.
Earlier files noted the decision alone and were expanded.
Each entry carries the instrument under which it was made.
Consultation is documented whether or not it altered anything.
Timing of publication is a field in its own right.
Nothing is filed without the level at which it was taken.
Review and appeal are tracked as distinct processes.
The convention is to preserve dissent in the record.
Two decisions on the same facts are expected to be reconcilable.
